Profile Center

Manage your Franklin profile.

Your free profile controls and optional Community Member visibility tools are together here. Manage your photo or logo, then—if you have Community Membership—create coupons, specials, sales, promotions, events and reviewed promotional graphics without hunting through hidden settings.

Open my profile toolsManage another profileMembership & billing
Free profile management stays free.

Claim access, factual corrections, removal requests and the reviewed basic profile photo/logo do not require Community Membership. Paid tools below are clearly separated and never affect factual accuracy or ordinary unpaid Directory order.

Before you edit

Use public-facing business or organization information only. Do not enter customer, patient, client, account, payment, medical, legal-case, password or private identity information. Photos and logos must be yours or content you have permission to publish.

How publishing works

Member promotional content is saved privately first and submitted for review. Only approved, current items appear publicly. Expired, removed, unapproved or membership-ineligible items stay off the public profile. Promotional image and flyer uploads currently support reviewed JPG/PNG/WebP input prepared as WebP; PDF uploads are not currently supported.
